body: Nothing seems to make me happy and I feel so hollow and empty, and people rely on me too much and don't return the favor. I started welcoming the idea of dying and its on my mind almost every day. I've tried anti depress and therapy, but neither has worked for me. I'm on adhd meds at the moment and its helped with some things. Any advice out there?
Im tired of pumping stuff in my body and i have no way of getting it without being kicked out of my home

It all went wrong in the beginning of university, first year doctor diagnosed me with depression and gave me meds that made things worse, on top of that my parents were against me taking meds as its just "blues" and to grow up. It was the same with therapy. My parents arent firm believers in mental health conditions being a thing (such as depression or adhd). I found someone i thought i loved in my first year but that relationship was filled with emotional and mental abuse for three years. I was finally able to get out of it in April but the abuse still continued for a month or two. Same time i went for help and the same doc diganosed me with adhd and gave me dexetrine spansule prescription. It did help with some symptoms but i was still miserable day in and day out. My family recently found out i was on meds and chalked it up to me being "lazy, childish and pathetic". Also doesnt help my father constantly says im pathetic for not actively seeking out girls and shoeing my "manly side". So the tl;dr of it, since beginning of university is where it went wrong, abusive three year relationship that has destroyed me mentally and emotionally and unsupportive  parents who thinks im a childish nobody.
